title: Closed intake reads closed: stop, reopen, and no dead links handed out
deviations_from_card: (1) The pure intake module is NOT a new app/features/tools/devcases/devcaseIntakeState.ts: intakeOf / intakeAction / lifecycleOwnsIntake / isPostingOpen live in the existing pure sibling DevCaseDetail.publish.ts, because app/page.tsx reaches CaseDetail through next/dynamic and sat at its module ceiling (1452 at base, 1455 now) - a new module would have been +1 over. The test keeps the card's name (devcaseIntakeState.test.ts) and imports the rule from DevCaseDetail.publish.ts. (2) The card's lifecycleStage input had no carrier on the detail: getDevCase (devcase.ts, in the write set) now selects the case's newest lifecycle stage in the case's own workspace (correlated subquery, by-id read) as DevCaseRecord.lifecycleStage, so GET /api/devcase/[id] hands the header what intakeAction needs; client DevCaseDetail type gains lifecycleStage. (3) closeCaseIntake takes the ownership predicate as a parameter (the route passes lifecycleOwnsIntake) instead of importing it: devcase.ts is on every studio route's graph and must not grow a module, and this keeps ONE rule shared by the header and the door. (4) A third code DEVCASE_INTAKE_ACTION_UNKNOWN (REFUSAL, 400) for a body that names an action other than 'stop' (card named two); 3 codes x 4 locales. (5) Existing source guard app/features/tools/devcases/devcase-studio-robustness.test.ts pinned the old trigger expression aria-expanded={confirmingPublish}; re-pinned to aria-expanded={stopOffered ? confirmingStop : confirmingPublish} and it now also forbids ANY confirming flag inside the trigger's disabled (the old focus-return defect). (6) The closed channel card shows no token at all (card said 'token as inert text'): a Closed chip plus 'Link closed...' copy, no URL, no copy pill, no SubmissionForm. (7) The publish confirm's existing copy 'It cannot be undone from here' was untrue once a stop exists; confirmBody reworded in all four locales. (8) Two lock-only commits beyond the card: perf-budget.json (see notes) and the api-reference regeneration.

AND status='open' (repeat = 0 changes, no second audit row); recordAudit ('intake_stopped', actor human, ref caseId, the case's workspace) runs after the transaction and only when closed > 0. REUSED CONTRACTS (not forked): the candidate side is the existing closed-intake contract (inbound/submit POSTING_CLOSED 410, the r06 intakeClosed flush) - the stop writes the same status the lifecycle close writes; the r07 fence (stopVerdict re-reads lifecycle stage, which the stop does not change) needed no edit; cv-analyze-workspace/A's ledgerStore()/registerKpFold and foldText are untouched (only the posted CTE gained open_count and the stage CASE; the facet query gained a status-aware EXISTS). APPLY-LINK SURFACES named: (a) channel card copy pill (DevApplyTokenPill via DevCaseDetailChannels) - hidden for a closed posting; (b) channel card manual-intake SubmissionForm - hidden for a closed posting; (c) header Publish button reading 'Published' on a closed case - now Reopen intake, which mints a fresh token (old stays 410); (d) waiting panel - says intake is closed; (e) Assignments ledger stage + stall chip - 'closed' not 'published'; (f) GET /api/devcase/postings and /[id]/channels still return a closed posting's token as data (the studio renders none of it; the workspace route's shape is pinned unchanged by slot A for the e2e journeys); (g) outbox letters - see loop_open. loop_open: (1) app/api/comms/[id]/resend/route.ts re-dispatches a stored case_invite body verbatim, so resending an invite whose posting is closed mails a link that answers 410 - rule: refuse (coded) or re-mint when kind === 'case_invite' and the token in the body resolves to a closed posting (getPostingByToken(...).status === 'closed'); needs a new REFUSAL code + 4 catalog entries. (2) app/_lib/stage-hooks-homework.ts inviteToCase finds no OPEN posting on a stopped case and publishes a fresh one, so moving a candidate into a homework column silently reopens intake a recruiter stopped - rule: consult the same intake state (a case whose postings exist but are all closed and whose lifecycle does not own intake was stopped by hand) and refuse with a coded 'intake_stopped' outcome instead of re-publishing, or record the reopen in the audit. Both are outside this write set (would grow it past the allowance) and are written into docs/features/dev-case/README.md Known gaps.
